text:
leo: hi folks, first day troubleshooting: my node app in docker-compose on mac M1 can't resolve service name 'db'. getting `ENOTFOUND db` from pg client.
leo: compose file:
leo: ```yaml
services:
  app:
    build: .
    environment:
      - PGHOST=db
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:13-alpine
networks:
  default:
    driver: bridge
```
leo: containers up but `getent hosts db` returns nothing; pinging the db IP works.
tasha: welcome! sounds like container DNS is okay at network level but node might be using c-ares/ipv6 ordering. try `NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first` or set `PGHOST=db` env.
leo: added NODE_OPTIONS and app connects. curious why `getent` didn't show name though.
tasha: on Docker Desktop, embedded DNS uses 127.0.0.11. Some images (musl vs glibc) have different resolution behavior. Alpine sometimes surprises node.
devex-bot: DevEx article: https://internal.redwood.dev/run/local-dev#compose-dns has tips.
nate: for debugging, run a scratch shell in the same network: `docker run --rm -it --network myrepo_default alpine sh` then `apk add bind-tools` and `dig db` to see DNS answers.
leo: thanks! I'll add a short note to onboarding README about node+alpine on mac M1.
